## Scale Snap {{VERSION}}

Keeps what you play in key, with 162 scales from many traditions. For Ableton Live 11 Suite, no Terminal needed.

### Install in 3 steps

1. **Download** [ScaleSnap-Ableton.zip](https://github.com/{{REPO}}/releases/download/{{TAG}}/ScaleSnap-Ableton.zip) and unzip it.
2. **Drag the `Scale Snap` folder** into Live's browser, onto **Places > User Library**
   (or put it in `~/Music/Ableton/User Library/` in Finder).
3. **Use it**: drag `Scale Snap.amxd` onto a MIDI track, in front of the instrument; drag `Scale Snap Detect.amxd` onto an audio track.

The latest version is always at
`https://github.com/{{REPO}}/releases/latest/download/ScaleSnap-Ableton.zip`
(this repository is private: you need to be signed in to GitHub).
